text: Select: compound name (pref_name), structure (canonical_smiles), mechanism description (mechanism_of_action), target ChEMBL ID (target_chembl_id), target name (target_pref_name). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno; drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid. Filter: max_phase = 4; action_type = 'ACTIVATOR'.
